summary: Iteration 36 — Validated (1) Trade Contracts seed endpoint idempotency + admin-only gating, (2) auto-pricing 'lights up' end-to-end via /api/economy/markets/{nation}/{city} for all 4 canonical combos, and (3) auto_restock + restock_target persistence through item CREATE + UPDATE + GET on the shared backend. Web admin 'Seed Trade Contracts' panel + button + result render correctly and returned 'created:0 · skipped:12 · 13 live market prices'. Web MyShop Add Item modal shows Auto-restock section with data-testid restock-section/toggle/target-input (toggle reveals target). Web AutoPricingSection lights up: Iron Ingots + Ironhold @ 30% markup shows 'Live retail price 65g' (was 'no active contract'). Mobile Expo web preview MyShop → shop-item form renders shop-item-restock-toggle + shop-item-restock-target correctly (default 10, revealed when toggled). Backend suite 7/7 passing. No functional bugs. One pre-existing data-quality note carried from iter35 (city list has near-duplicate entries) still present.
action_items: (Optional data cleanup, carried over from iter35) City dropdown in the shop-item Auto-pricing picker still has near-duplicate entries e.g. "Astra'Lun (aigraels)" twice and "Ancestor Hall" vs "Ancestorhall" (dhor-kuldor). Not a code bug — seeded data noise.
(Code-quality, low priority) PUT /api/items/{item_id} still requires the full ItemCreate body — same partial-update anti-pattern flagged in iter35.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_starter_contracts() is correctly idempotent (POST twice returns created:0 skipped:12) and returns the required shape {created, skipped, contracts[], available_market_rows}.
Route /api/economy/admin/seed-contracts is correctly admin-gated (401 without auth).

auto_restock + restock_target round-trip cleanly through POST /api/shops/{shop_id}/items and PUT /api/items/{item_id}; both fields visible on the item objects returned by GET /api/shops/{shop_id}/items.

Web RestockSection component uses the exact data-testids requested (restock-section, restock-toggle, restock-target-input); Mobile uses SHOP.restockToggle=shop-item-restock-toggle and SHOP.restockTarget=shop-item-restock-target as spec'd.
